title: Incommunicable
summary: INCOMMU'NICABLE, a. [in and communicable.] 1. That cannot be communicated or imparted to others.2. That cannot or may not be communicated, told or revealed to others.

inlines.v: INCOMMU'NICABLE, a. [in and communicable.] 1. That cannot be communicated or imparted to others.2. That cannot or may not be communicated, told or revealed to others.
